items.title: Wellman Braud Interview, 1958-03-31
items.q: When you had Bache and Lawrence Dewey both, did they both play clarinet... No. Bache were playing clarinet at the time.

ctx.x: When you used the two clarinets, did they play in harmony? Or did Cape Turnabout have any solos? Or one band record.

He played a plagata to what Lawrence Dewey played. And sometime, he played the top. He played the lead. And he could play a plagata. Well, that comes from natural ability. Man, just real artists. You know what I mean? And for, for singer, well, he's the best in the world. He's the best in the world. And the next best I heard for singer since, including Basset, was Biggar. And, Bonnie Biggar with Louis Armstrong, played more clarinet. Obligata and filling in than anybody I know outside of Sidney Basset. Because he…
